name: Deriv Trading
description: Trade Deriv Synthetic Indices: live quotes, candles, technical indicators, backtest, buy/close with approval.
help: Connects to Deriv's public WebSocket API (api.derivws.com). Read-only tools need no token. Account and trading tools need an API token. Every order requires user approval (risk=purchase).

fields.label: Deriv API Token
fields.description: Deriv API token (demo token VRTC... can never trade real money). Leave empty for read-only tools.

fields.label: App ID
fields.description: Deriv application ID. Register your own at https://developers.deriv.com

fields.label: Allow Live Trading
fields.description: Set 'true' to allow orders on a real account. Default false blocks all real-account orders.

fields.label: Max Stake per Trade
fields.description: Maximum stake per contract in currency units (hard cap).

fields.label: Max Open Positions
fields.description: Maximum number of concurrent open contracts.

fields.label: Daily Loss Limit
fields.description: Session-level daily loss limit in currency units. Blocks new orders once reached.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Live spot price (bid/ask) for a Deriv synthetic symbol. No token needed.

symbol.description: Symbol code, e.g. R_75, BOOM500, CRASH500, JD50

tools.name: candles
tools.description: OHLC candle history for a symbol. No token needed.

tools.name: symbols
tools.description: List all active synthetic symbols with display names and market status.

tools.name: contracts_for
tools.description: Available contract types, durations, barriers, min/max stake for a symbol.

tools.name: indicators
tools.description: Technical indicators (RSI, EMA, ATR, Bollinger Bands) computed from recent candles.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Account balance, currency, and demo/real status. Needs API token.

tools.name: positions
tools.description: Open contracts with entry price, current P/L, and expiry. Needs API token.

tools.name: backtest
tools.description: Walk-forward backtest of a strategy on historical ticks. Out-of-sample result only.

stake.description: Stake fraction of equity per trade

spread_bp.description: Round-trip spread cost in basis points

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Place a Deriv contract. Requires API token + user approval (risk=purchase).

contract_type.description: Call | Put | Rise | Fall | Higher | Lower | ... (see contracts_for)

tools.name: close
tools.description: Sell an open contract. Requires API token + user approval (risk=purchase).
